name: silvershop-suite/delivery-scheduling
description: Delivery and pickup time-slot scheduling for SilverShop (CMS 6): recurring weekly windows with per-slot capacity, lead/prep time, a same-day cutoff and an ASAP-or-scheduled choice, with a checkout date + slot picker injected into the shipping-method step and the chosen window stored on the order. The shared timing primitive for both self-delivery and click & collect pickup.

suggest.silvershop-suite/click-and-collect: Adds the collect-in-store fulfilment choice; its pickup orders reuse this module's windows (pickup slots come from here, not a second slot engine).
suggest.silvershop-suite/shippability: A cart with pickup-only lines forces the pickup mode, so only pickup windows are offered.
suggest.silvershop-suite/delivery-zones: Per-zone delivery availability + fee + minimum order; v2 can restrict a window to matched zones.
suggest.silvershop/shipping: Supplies the stepped-checkout shipping-method step this module injects the slot picker into.
suggest.silvershop-suite/product-status: A cart's longest made-to-order expected date floors the earliest selectable window.
suggest.silvershop-suite/store-profile: Shop name + address shown on the scheduled / out-for-delivery emails (and the future open-hours / radius origin home).
suggest.silvershop-suite/notification-log: Logs the delivery.scheduled / delivery.out_for_delivery emails from the stamped header (fulfilment audit).
suggest.silvershop-suite/order-admin: Surfaces the chosen window + the out-for-delivery action in the modern order screen (this module ships a standalone Scheduling tab otherwise).
suggest.silvershop-suite/store-locations: Slots per physical store, skipped on that store's closed days (exceptions, holidays, temporary closure); pickup orders only see their store's slots.
